note: City of Emmetsburg campground on the southeast shore of Five Island Lake, beside Sewell Park and two city cabins; bath house and playground. The sites face the lake across the loop road and Lake Shore Drive. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $30, 21 full-hookup 30/50A sites, drop-box FCFS, no reservations. Lakeview confirmed: every pad has its own loop road and the public Lake Shore Drive between it and the lake, so none can be on-water. Website moved (old URL is a 404); phone differs. Pin ~125 m from the pads, fine.
flags: WATERFRONT (lakeview confirmed; no on-water pad): on the city map and NAIP the front row (sites 1-8) is ~35-45 m from the shore, but the campground's own one-way loop road and then the public Lake Shore Drive run between every pad and the lake. A driveway or road in the way rules out on-water. The view is open across mown grass and the road; the city calls it 'lakeside camping'.
WEBSITE: the stored https://emmetsburg.com/campgrounds/ now redirects to a 404 on the city's new CivicPlus site. The current page is https://www.emmetsburg.com/214/Campgrounds.
PHONE: the stored 712-852-2924 isn't on the city page. City Hall's 712-852-4030 is the number the city gives (for the cabins) and the one Google shows for the campground.
Bath house on the city map; whether it has showers isn't stated, so facilities were left unset.
